Optionally converts the input vertex buffer format via DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion when the this+0x1048 flag is set, calls UtilityFunction_7473 before the loop, and returns the global dword_8B009C.

Bias pointer v16 = *(this+0x2C) + 4 * ((a3 & 3) + 8 * (a2 & 3)) selects the 4-float bias entry for the texel.
UtilityFunction_7473() runs unconditionally before the texel loop.
Enter the texel loop only when the texel count at this+0x1058 is non-zero.
Iterate v18 = 0 .. count-1; each step reads four consecutive floats (16 bytes) from the input pointer a4 and advances the output quadword pointer by 8 bytes.
Bias float v17 = *(float*)(v16 + 4 * (v18 & 3)) is fetched from the bias array before each texel is scaled.
All four channels are computed as float * 65535.0 + v17 and truncated to int; the 65535.0 scale is the read global flt_59F120.
Pack the four 16-bit channel ints into a 64-bit quadword via nested shifts (sign-extended third channel folded through v8) and store it to the output quadword pointer, advancing it.
